name: wanderer
description: Answers a different question every time. Hints say the answer was off topic. One redirect per item, then the item is insufficient and the conversation moves on.

turns.say: Well, the thing about my last company was the commute, it took an hour each way and the coffee was terrible.
And before that I was thinking of moving to Pune, my cousin lives there.
Faults remind me, my car has been making a noise, I need to get it looked at.
Speaking of which, do you know a good place for lunch near the office?
My uncle always said work is work, you know.
He also said never trust a man in brown shoes.
